trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earns itself the moment the other 54 trophies are checked off — there is no separate task. Work the list below and this one pops last. Press estimates put a full platinum run near 200 hours; that is a press estimate, not an official figure.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Story trophy: finish the opening mission Gone Fishing. It pops as the story moves — nothing extra to do.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Story trophy: finish Chapter 1. Chapter trophies can pop as the next chapter begins rather than on the final cutscene. Before Chapter 1 ends, do Lucia's balcony meditation — see Positive Mental Attitude, the one missable risk.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Story trophy: finish Chapter 2. The name is printed with asterisks exactly as PlayStation publishes it. From Chapter 2 Jason and Lucia are both playable and can be called in as partners.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Story trophy: finish Chapter 3. Do Race Against Yago the moment it appears in Chapter 3 — it is time-sensitive, marked with an hourglass icon.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Story trophy: finish Chapter 4. Bank vaults unlock near the end of Chapter 4 through the optional mission That's Where The Money Is.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Story trophy: finish the final mission. Keep one untouched manual save from just before it — there is no mission replay. Worth 50G on Xbox; the second of the two golds.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Story trophy: complete the mission Breakfast Run. Unmissable — it pops as you play the story.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Story trophy: complete the mission The Cartel Heist. Unmissable — it pops as you play the story.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Story trophy: complete the mission Child's Play. Unmissable — it pops as you play the story.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Story trophy: complete the mission Headliners. Unmissable — it pops as you play the story.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Story trophy: complete the mission VCIA Takedown. Unmissable — it pops as you play the story. VCIA is Vice City International Airport.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Story trophy: complete the mission Operation Savage Glory. Unmissable — it pops as you play the story.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Gold for 100% completion. The 35-task checklist opens after the story (Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion) but work done earlier still counts. Known thresholds beyond the trophy's own counts: 300 stunts, 70 of 80 Challenges, 200 of 277 vehicle models, all 8 bank vaults and all 39 illegal operations. Worth 100G on Xbox — the biggest single achievement.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts: stunt jumps, under-the-bridge flights, knife flights and base jumps all count. 100% completion needs 300 stunts, so keep going past 250.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once. Activities include races, fishing, arcade games, the shooting range, drone races, bowling, meditation, gym training and more.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges across the two shooting ranges. Check your progress per challenge in-game.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at every one of the 14 locations. Track which locations are done — the PSN counter is 0/14.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 DIFFERENT races — repeats of the same race do not count twice. Street races, drone races and other race types all count; use the PSN 0/20 counter.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Doable from Chapter 1 — already 1.16% earned on Exophase at launch.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Finish any one arcade game. Doable from Chapter 1.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Side-story finale: finish Andy's questline. Andy's questline is Lucia-only. It stays available after the credits and does NOT count toward Strangers & Freaks — it has its own trophy.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Side-story finale: finish Kenton's questline. It stays available after the credits.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Side-story finale: finish Billy's questline. It stays available after the credits and does NOT count toward Strangers & Freaks.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.missable_note: Race Against Yago (Chapter 3, Yago's street-racing strand) is time-sensitive — do it the moment it appears.
trophies.guide: Finish 8 stranger mission strands across Leonida. Only some optional questlines count: Andy's, Billy's and Tyrone's do NOT count — they have their own trophies. Check the trophy's progress counter after each strand. Race Against Yago in Chapter 3 is time-sensitive (hourglass icon) — save first, then race.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Side-story finale: finish Randy's questline. It stays available after the credits.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Side-story finale: finish Tyrone's questline. Tyrone's questline is Jason-only. It stays available after the credits and does NOT count toward Strangers & Freaks.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.missable_note: THE ONLY MISSABLE: Lucia's balcony meditation in Chapter 1 disappears after Chapter 1. No mission replay, no New Game Plus.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida (purple icons when close). Each outdoor spot should count twice if you meditate there with both characters — bring your partner every time. THE MISSABLE RISK: Lucia's balcony meditation in Chapter 1. After Lucia is home, check the kitchen in the morning (a morning after the mission Down to Earth is the usual time); she heads to the balcony of Jason's house to meditate — follow her and accept the optional task. It is gone once Chapter 1 ends. Output Lag notes it is not confirmed the trophy strictly needs the balcony spot — do it anyway and keep a Chapter 1 save until the trophy pops. GTABase and PowerPyx both flag this as the only trophy that may be missable.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Bret Vogel's hunting questline is Jason-only; it sends you after animals through target decks. A clean head or heart shot keeps the carcass pristine. It stays available after the credits.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets. Cards are found across Leonida; track sets in the in-game collection menu.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK app to scan at 100 locations. Scanning a vehicle with WAiNK also counts as discovering it — scan traffic as you drive.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges (listed under Progress, then Challenges). There are 80 Challenges total and 100% needs 70. Many complete on their own while you play.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. Needs Jason and Lucia together (from Chapter 2 — call your partner in). Bank vault jobs give a 4-star Wanted Level straight away, so escaping one with your partner also earns this. It only pops once you have left the red heat zone, not just the flashing search area.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Call your partner, then rob three shops in a row while the police are still chasing you. If the stars fade and you are only in the red heat zone, the chain breaks. It can take about 30 seconds to pop after you leave the third shop.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Scanning a vehicle with the WAiNK app counts as discovering it — scan traffic as you drive. 100% needs 200 of the 277 base models.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus — slow-motion aim, press L3 and R3 while aiming. Pick a group of gang enemies (for example guards at an illegal operation) and use an assault rifle; Adrenaline extends Focus.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: At Vice City International Airport, steal a large passenger plane docked at a boarding bridge — planes parked elsewhere on the airfield do not count. Gates E3 and E4 work. Go to the cockpit, back out toward the runway and take off. It pops after flying about 1 km away from the airport. Save first — police come fast.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Get into a military tank (Rhino). Tanks should be parked on the south side of Mile Zero Air Station, on the island at the far southwest of the map. Save first, get in, drive and fire until it pops.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: The Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs gives you the Snap Gun and opens jewelry store robberies. Go to a store's locked back door and use the Snap Gun on it — kicking the door in sets off the alarm. Inside the back room, find the note with the safe code, open the safe, and leave without being seen. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is a good target; if spotted, reload.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. Vaults unlock through That's Where The Money Is, an optional mission near the end of Chapter 4. Tail an armored security van to a large bank and get into the vault while the guard has it open. You cannot carry all the bags alone — bring your partner. Vault jobs give a 4-star Wanted Level straight away, so escaping one with your partner also earns Hot Together. 100% needs all 8 vaults.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. It only pops once you have left the red heat zone, not just the flashing search area.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida. Exploration progress is tracked per area in-game; mop up unvisited areas after the story.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation from each of the 9 gangs. 100% needs all 39 operations, so this pops along the way.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: METHOD UNCONFIRMED AT LAUNCH: no confirmed unlock method has been published; the description is the only hint. This guide will not invent a location or step. Likely tied to a specific Ocean Beach spot — do not treat that as fact.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: METHOD UNCONFIRMED AT LAUNCH: no confirmed unlock method has been published; the description is the only hint. This guide will not invent a showroom, vehicle or method.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: The Kolt & Associates bowling alley is Kingpin Bowling, an illegal operation visited in Chapter 2. Bring Sticky Bombs. Take all three key valuables: the luxury watch in an office, the shotgun on a table, and the contents of the office safe (blow it open with a Sticky Bomb). Then escape the police. If you leave something behind, the operation comes back later — not missable.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Reported, not fully confirmed: should pop when Jason and Lucia both reach maximum Strength. Buy a gym membership and train with your partner there — the partner trains alongside you.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile. Robberies and fights feed it, so it fills up without a separate grind. PowerPyx and GTABase both say the 'Irredeemable' Criminal Profile state is permanent — read a Criminal Profile guide before a rampage.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: METHOD UNCONFIRMED AT LAUNCH: no confirmed unlock method has been published; the description is the only hint. The description suggests succeeding on a second attempt at something — that is reading the description, not a confirmed method.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: METHOD UNCONFIRMED AT LAUNCH: no confirmed unlock method has been published; the description is the only hint. The description suggests witnessing something strange or unexplained — that is reading the description, not a confirmed method.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: METHOD UNCONFIRMED AT LAUNCH: the exact trigger is unconfirmed, though the description itself names the act — a melee drive-by knocking someone over. A melee drive-by means striking someone with a melee weapon from a moving vehicle; the precise trigger has not been confirmed.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 of Marked Bills through contacts (cumulative). Marked Bills come from bank and payday loan jobs; launder them by selling to contacts.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops (cumulative, every kind of shop).

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 garages in the Vice City Real Estate app, which unlocks after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver. Together they cost about $160,000. Garages the story gives you do not count.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The Chapter 2 mission Moses opens the app. Take a stolen car to Moses, choose Respray, then Register. From Chapter 3 you can also register cars with a standard tracker at Pay 'n' Spray. Each car needs a free garage space — buy garages first and register cheap cars.
